verses.html: 1 Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus,
verses.text: 1 Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus,

verses.html: 2 and they saw some of His disciples eating with hands that were defiled—that is, unwashed.
verses.text: 2 and they saw some of His disciples eating with hands that were defiled—that is, unwashed.

verses.html: 3 Now in holding to the tradition of the elders, the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat until they wash their hands ceremonially.
verses.text: 3 Now in holding to the tradition of the elders, the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat until they wash their hands ceremonially.

verses.html: 4 And on returning from the market, they do not eat unless they wash. And there are many other traditions for them to observe, including the washing of cups, pitchers, kettles, and couches for dining.
verses.text: 4 And on returning from the market, they do not eat unless they wash. And there are many other traditions for them to observe, including the washing of cups, pitchers, kettles, and couches for dining.

verses.html: 5 So the Pharisees and scribes questioned Jesus: “Why do Your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders? Instead, they eat with defiled hands.”
verses.text: 5 So the Pharisees and scribes questioned Jesus: “Why do Your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders? Instead, they eat with defiled hands.”

verses.html: 6 Jesus answered them, “Isaiah prophesied correctly about you hypocrites, as it is written: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.
verses.text: 6 Jesus answered them, “Isaiah prophesied correctly about you hypocrites, as it is written: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.

verses.html: 7 They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’
verses.text: 7 They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’

verses.html: 8 You have disregarded the commandment of God to keep the tradition of men.”
verses.text: 8 You have disregarded the commandment of God to keep the tradition of men.”

verses.html: 1 And the Pharisees and some of the scribes, having come from Jerusalem, are being gathered to him.
verses.text: 1 And the Pharisees and some of the scribes, having come from Jerusalem, are being gathered to him.

verses.html: 2 And having seen some of his disciples, that they eat loaves with defiled hands, that is, unwashed—
verses.text: 2 And having seen some of his disciples, that they eat loaves with defiled hands, that is, unwashed—

verses.html: 3 for the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they would wash their hands with a fist, holding to the tradition of the elders;
verses.text: 3 for the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they would wash their hands with a fist, holding to the tradition of the elders;

verses.html: 4 and from a marketplace, they do not eat unless they baptize, and there are many other things which they received to hold to: baptisms of cups and pitchers and copper vessels—
verses.text: 4 and from a marketplace, they do not eat unless they baptize, and there are many other things which they received to hold to: baptisms of cups and pitchers and copper vessels—

verses.html: 5 also the Pharisees and the scribes ask him, “Why do your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders, but they eat bread with defiled hands?”
verses.text: 5 also the Pharisees and the scribes ask him, “Why do your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders, but they eat bread with defiled hands?”

verses.html: 6 But he, answering, said to them, “Isaiah prophesied well about you hypocrites. As it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far away from me.
verses.text: 6 But he, answering, said to them, “Isaiah prophesied well about you hypocrites. As it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far away from me.

verses.html: 7 But they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines commandments of men.’
verses.text: 7 But they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines commandments of men.’

verses.html: 8 Having left the commandment of God, you hold to the tradition of men.”
verses.text: 8 Having left the commandment of God, you hold to the tradition of men.”

verses.html: 1 After that, some Pharisees and some teachers of the Jewish law arrived from the city of Jerusalem. They assembled where Jesus was.
verses.text: 1 After that, some Pharisees and some teachers of the Jewish law arrived from the city of Jerusalem. They assembled where Jesus was.

verses.html: 2 Then, they noticed that some of Jesus’ apprentices did not cleanse their hands before eating food. So, their hands were unclean {when they ate the food}.
verses.text: 2 Then, they noticed that some of Jesus’ apprentices did not cleanse their hands before eating food. So, their hands were unclean {when they ate the food}.

verses.html: 3 {The Pharisees and the teachers of the Jewish law noticed that} because most Jewish people, and especially the Pharisees, always cleanse their hands in a special way before they eat food. That is the teaching that they received from their ancestors.
verses.text: 3 {The Pharisees and the teachers of the Jewish law noticed that} because most Jewish people, and especially the Pharisees, always cleanse their hands in a special way before they eat food. That is the teaching that they received from their ancestors.

verses.html: 4 Also, {when they come home} from the open areas in their towns, they always cleanse themselves before they eat food. They have many other similar teachings. {For example,} they cleanse many different kinds of dishes and containers.
verses.text: 4 Also, {when they come home} from the open areas in their towns, they always cleanse themselves before they eat food. They have many other similar teachings. {For example,} they cleanse many different kinds of dishes and containers.

verses.html: 5 So, the Pharisees and the teachers of the Jewish law told Jesus, “Your apprentices have unclean hands when they eat food. They are disobeying the teachings we received from our ancestors. They should not do that!”
verses.text: 5 So, the Pharisees and the teachers of the Jewish law told Jesus, “Your apprentices have unclean hands when they eat food. They are disobeying the teachings we received from our ancestors. They should not do that!”

verses.html: 6 Jesus replied, “Isaiah {the prophet} was right when God spoke through him about you. You say that you obey God, but you really do not! Here is what Isaiah wrote: ‘You people treat me respectfully when you talk, but you do not really care about me.
verses.text: 6 Jesus replied, “Isaiah {the prophet} was right when God spoke through him about you. You say that you obey God, but you really do not! Here is what Isaiah wrote: ‘You people treat me respectfully when you talk, but you do not really care about me.

verses.html: 7 When you worship me, it is useless. {That is because} you use only what humans have commanded to instruct others.’
verses.text: 7 When you worship me, it is useless. {That is because} you use only what humans have commanded to instruct others.’

verses.html: 8 You carefully obey human teachings, but you ignore the laws that God gave us.”
verses.text: 8 You carefully obey human teachings, but you ignore the laws that God gave us.”

verses.html: 1 Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.
verses.text: 1 Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

verses.html: 2 Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.
verses.text: 2 Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.

verses.html: 3 (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.
verses.text: 3 (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

verses.html: 4 They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)
verses.text: 4 They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)

verses.html: 5 The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”
verses.text: 5 The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”

verses.html: 6 He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
verses.text: 6 He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

verses.html: 7 They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’
verses.text: 7 They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’

verses.html: 8 “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”
verses.text: 8 “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”
